# Vendored UI styles

`shadcn-tailwind.css` is copied unchanged from `shadcn@4.21.0`, `package/dist/tailwind.css`, distributed under the adjacent MIT license.
Keeping this stylesheet avoids installing the shadcn CLI and its MCP/glob dependencies at build or runtime.

Update the stylesheet and license together when changing the UI style baseline. Verify visual and interaction tests after an update.
